reason: A is the better proposal because a generic, experimentally verified nanoscale precipitate dispersion is physically plausible for increasing dislocation storage and delaying adiabatic localization, whereas B assumes coherent L12 precipitates in a BCC Hf–Zr–Ti–Ta matrix without thermodynamic or crystallographic support and conflates precipitation with chemical short-range order. A still needs phase-selection evidence, explicit processing parameters, and literature support, but it avoids B’s unsupported 10–20% prediction and citations that do not demonstrate L12 precipitation.
